title: A Hundred Years Wrong
description: The urchin walks you one block up the High Street — gas lamps, a parked motorcar, the Syndicate shaking down a shopkeep in broad daylight. The rift never closed; the echo soaked into this age's masters. The lad points you at the constabulary steps: the desk sergeant is half on the take like the rest, but he'll hear you out once you've thinned the crew that owns his street. Put some Legbreakers and a bent Constable or two on the cobbles first.

objectives.desc: Break up the Syndicate Legbreakers working the High Street
Put down the Constables on the take
